name: dsh-dag-plugin
description: DSH Multi-Agent DAG plugin monorepo: dsh-dag-core (framework-free orchestration core) + dsh-dag (DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin)

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/dag-core && npm run build -w packages/dsh-dag
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/dag-core && npm run typecheck -w packages/dsh-dag
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/dag-core && npm run test -w packages/dsh-dag
